eir.0540 = {
	type = character_event
	title = eir.0540.t
	desc = eir.0540.desc
	theme = marriage

	trigger = {
		eir_small_realm_trigger = yes
		NOT = { has_character_flag = eir_early_cd }
		any_ruler = {
			is_ai = yes
			is_ruler = yes
			culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
			NOT = { this = root }
			NOT = { is_vassal_of = root }
		}
	}

	immediate = {
		random_ruler = {
			limit = {
				is_ai = yes
				is_ruler = yes
				culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
				NOT = { this = root }
				NOT = { is_vassal_of = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_pact_chief
		}
		add_character_flag = { flag = eir_early_cd years = 2 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0540.a
		stress_impact = {
			generous = minor_stress_impact_loss
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = eir_hospitality_modifier years = 6 }
		add_hook = { target = scope:eir_pact_chief type = favor_hook }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 35
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = generous
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0540.b
		stress_impact = {
			greedy = minor_stress_impact_loss
			generous = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		random_list = {
			55 = {
				desc = eir.out.t540w
				modifier = {
					add = 15
					diplomacy >= 10
				}
				remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
				add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			}
			45 = {
				desc = eir.out.t540l
				add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
			}
		}
		ai_chance = {
			base = 40
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = greedy
			}
			modifier = {
				add = 10
				has_trait = shrewd
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0540.c
		trigger = {
			learning >= 8
		}
		stress_impact = {
			humble = minor_stress_impact_loss
			arrogant = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_gain
		add_trait_xp = { trait = lifestyle_poet value = 20 }
		scope:eir_pact_chief = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = eir_fair_dealing_opinion opinion = 25 } }
		ai_chance = { base = 25 }
	}

	option = {
		name = eir.0540.d
		stress_impact = {
			content = minor_stress_impact_loss
			ambitious = minor_stress_impact_gain
		}
		add_stress = minor_stress_loss
		add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss

			base = 15
			modifier = {
				add = 15
				has_trait = content
			}
		}
	}

	type = character_event

				NOT = { this = root }
				NOT = { is_vassal_of = root }
			}
			save_scope_as = eir_pact_chief
		}
	}
